race.comment: BROOKELINDA (9) was in the betting in a pretty decent Open 2yo back in March conducted at Sandown. She got a fair way back in that race and was tipped straight out. Every chance she will be much better for that. Has had four trials to be ready. MYSTIC RIVER QUEEN (10) showed good speed at her debut over the short course at Mornington. It won't take much for her to lift off that with experience. ALPINE POINT (1) had an up and down first campaign. But his subsequent trials suggest he has turned the corner. EXACTING STANDARD (2) was not far away but in a weak Yarra Valley maiden. Probably needs to find a bit more. TRUANT (8) has raced in lower maidens but comes from a leading yard at Lindsay Park.
